title: Introducing TrGLUE and SentiTurca: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Turkish General Language Understanding and Sentiment Analysis
findings: The paper introduced the Turkish Hate Map benchmark which includes 'Religion' and 'Sects' (specifically branches of Islam like Shiism, Hanafism, Sunnism, Shafiism, and groups like Alevis) as target categories for hate speech detection. This was motivated by the long-standing sectarian divides in Turkish society. While model performances were analyzed on the overall hate speech task, there were no specific findings reported for performance on religious categories versus other categories.
